sources.title: welf1003: Topic 6 Microskills 2 – questioning
sources.quote: What would need to occur today for you to feel that our session had been helpful?
sources.technique: Use purposeful, open questions to explore the client’s concerns and expectations, including what would make the conversation helpful, rather than following a pre-set agenda.

sources.title: OARS Model: Essential Communication Skills
sources.quote: Explore, clarify and gain an understanding of your client’s world.
sources.technique: First explore the client’s experiences, thoughts, feelings, beliefs, and hopes with open questions, then reflect what you heard and check your understanding of their goals and preferences.
